decision.explanation: Document D2S2 explicitly states that 'Australia's Ashleigh Barty finishes the year as the WTA Year-End World No.1 for the second straight year' in 2020. This directly supports the claim that she was the women's year-end No. 1 in tennis in 2020. Document D3S2 incorrectly names Angelique Kerber as the year-end No. 1, likely due to an error or misattribution. Only Ashleigh Barty is supported by the correct source for the requested year and position.
